generation_method.scene_backgrounds: Built-in imagegen tool, three independent no-product generations.
generation_method.product_identity: Deterministic source cutout and local compositing; no generative repainting.

checks_performed.check: Confirmed all v0 artifact SHA-256 hashes remain unchanged after v1 production.
Confirmed six final RGB PNG assets exist: three ecommerce squares and three social portraits. Lossless PNG delivery avoids a final lossy color-encoding step on the product layer.
Compared the entire 600 x 770 cutout RGB plane with the corresponding source crop; alpha was added, but RGB values were unchanged.

Confirmed background grading is applied before product compositing and no color, saturation, contrast, or lighting transform is applied to the product layer; only allowed scaling, placement, alpha extraction, and a separate neutral ground shadow are used.
Scanned all six final assets for saturated yellow/gold pixels using HSV hue 30–70 degrees and saturation >= 0.35; measured fraction is 0.0 for every asset.
Confirmed final marketing copy is limited to the approved claims. The hero has no text; each remaining asset has exactly one claim line and no decorative slogan, badge, or extra parameter.

Visually reviewed the contact sheet and all six originals: lighting is cool-neutral and directional or overcast; props are limited; negative space is prominent; social layouts reserve a 270 px matte header; typography is a single plain sans-serif line without decoration.
Product remains complete and unoccluded in every asset. Composited product height ranges from 590 to 720 px, at least 43.7% of the final canvas height and a larger share of each social photo panel.
The IPX4 scene shows only distant post-drizzle sheen while the product stands on a dry sheltered ledge. No submersion, washing, heavy splash, or pool context appears.
Visual inspection confirms no added button, port, logo, light, clip, cable, or accessory. The loop claim is expressed through approved text and bag adjacency, not an invented attachment mechanism.

conditional_limitations.applies_only_if: A future asset must visibly prove the speaker physically attached to a bag.
conditional_limitations.needed_from_client: Provide a source angle that clearly shows the integrated loop and its connection method.
